description.value: Lucky's Exotic Bodega is a specialty convenience store and bodega on Vancouver's East Side, stocking an eclectic mix of exotic snacks and beverages sourced from around the world alongside streetwear, sneakers, and smoke accessories. It has a strong local following amplified through Instagram (@Luckysbodega) and operates its own e-commerce platform with free local delivery. Touring cyclists passing through the area can resupply on chips, candy, energy drinks, water, and other packaged foods in an distinctly non-chain environment.

raw_osm.description: Lucky's Exotic Bodega specializes in exotic snacks from all over the world, sneakers, streetwear and smoke accessories.
raw_osm.name: Lucky's Exotic Bodega

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a convenience shop with a physical address at 1361 East 41st Avenue, Vancouver; the website corroborates an active, real business (Shopify storefront with product categories, promotions, and social media presence). The website content confirms the business sells snacks, candy, chips, beverages (water, milk, juice, energy drinks), cereal, and ice cream, supporting the 'basic groceries' amenity as specialty convenience foods. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: Website content is dominated by the Shopify currency-selector dropdown, obscuring detailed page content and preventing confirmation of phone number or physical address from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active convenience store with a functioning website and physical OSM address; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: specialty convenience store and bodega... strong local following amplified through Instagram
